description: Ball squeeze between the knees with a Kegel: how to do it, how to tell it works, common mistakes, and easier and harder versions you can do seated.
intro: The ball squeeze is a seated move: press a ball between your knees and add a pelvic floor squeeze at the same time. The inner thighs work alongside the pelvic floor, so many people find the Kegel easier to locate. Unlike most hip and leg moves, it trains the pelvic floor directly.
feel: Your inner thighs press, and inside you feel a gentle lift and squeeze, as if stopping the flow of urine and holding in gas. After the hold, everything lets go fully. You should not feel your buttocks doing all the work, bearing down or breath holding. Self-check: try one rep without the ball; if you feel nothing inside, the thighs did it all.

mistakes.wrong: Squeezing the ball as hard as you can
mistakes.right: Use moderate pressure and focus on the lift inside.
Release the ball and the pelvic floor completely, and rest as long as you squeezed.
Sit tall on your sit bones with your feet flat. Slouching makes the pelvic floor harder to engage.

easier: Hold 2–3 seconds instead of five and do fewer reps. Or squeeze the ball alone at first and add the Kegel once you can feel it.
harder: Build toward a 10-second hold with normal breathing, or add a few quick squeezes after each hold.
who: Useful for desk workers, women working on bladder control, men with post-void dribbling, and anyone who struggles to find their pelvic floor.
skip: If you have pelvic pain, pain with sex or a pelvic floor that feels tight, see a pelvic floor physiotherapist first, because more squeezing may not help. Also get checked after recent pelvic surgery or birth. Stop if it hurts.

faq.q: Does the ball squeeze help with bladder control?
faq.a: It may help, because it trains the pelvic floor muscles that support the bladder. It takes regular practice over weeks, and leaks that persist are worth getting checked.

faq.q: Can men do the ball squeeze?
faq.a: Yes. The pelvic floor works the same basic way in men, and the ball can make the muscles easier to locate. It fits easily into a desk break.
